description: A very extensive set of extension methods that allow you to more naturally specify the expected outcome of a TDD or BDD-style unit tests. Targets .NET Framework 4.7, as well as .NET Core 2.1, .NET Core 3.0, .NET 6, .NET Standard 2.0 and 2.1. Supports the unit test frameworks MSTest2, NUnit3, XUnit2, MSpec, and NSpec3.
commit_message:
Add generic-math numeric assertions on net8.0 (#3395)

* Add generic-math numeric assertions on .NET 8

Add the net8.0 target framework and, on .NET 8 or later, a generic Should()
for INumber<T> types such as Half and NFloat, plus BeApproximately and
NotBeApproximately (including nullable variants) for any IFloatingPoint<T>.

Several BCL types also implement INumber<T> on .NET 8. Explicit overloads
keep the previous assertion types for char, BigInteger, Int128, UInt128,
nint, nuint and their nul
